law.boundary: K'UHUL owns alpha and theta; backend bindings supply backend, entrypoint, dispatch, and contract evidence.

Pop.post: output is a distribution over N(k)

Wo.post: output is B_W subset_of B_P plus rejection outcome

Sek.pre: input is B_Y and policy Pi

Xul.pre: input is B_C and policy Pi

fold_field_binding.note: FoldField = vertex in G_runtime = G_semantic □ G_phase. Each phase binding alpha_theta has an associated FoldField (node_id, theta, W, C, R). fold_relevance() is the product-graph edge weight between two bindings. ConvergenceTest tracks whether the Kleene iteration over FoldStates converges to Xul.
fold_field_binding.convergence_invariant: (Fold∘Unfold)(h) ≡ h; violation drops sigma to UNBOUND and blocks the Xul commit path

@contract.post: output is a distribution over N(k)

bindings.@notes: Pop gathers the semantic neighborhood distribution without claiming truth.

@contract.post: output is B_W subset_of B_P plus rejection outcome

bindings.@notes: Wo constrains Pop output and may reject, but it does not collapse UNKNOWN to else.
Yax expands candidate branches while preserving unresolved alternatives.

@contract.pre: input is B_Y and policy Pi

bindings.@notes: Sek runs policy-authorized operators over candidates.
Ch'en observes/verifies; MISS and UNKNOWN remain distinct from contradiction.

@contract.pre: input is B_C and policy Pi

bindings.@notes: Xul may collapse computation only through policy; semantic certainty is not fabricated.

V2.name: phase_is_a_kuhul_phase
V2.check: @phase is one of Pop, Wo, Yax, Sek, Ch'en, Xul

V5.name: binding_identity_is_unique
V5.check: no two bindings claim the same (@fold, @phase, @backend) triple

V6.name: fallback_is_contract_bound
V6.check: a declared @fallback names a backend that a binding of the same fold and phase provides

V7.name: executor_is_not_semantic_law
V7.check: no binding asserts verification or commit authority, and a Ch'en/Xul binding is executed by XCFE, never by a model backend

resolution.fallback_rule: an exact (fold, phase, backend) binding wins; otherwise a binding of the same fold and phase may answer through its declared @fallback
resolution.capability_rule: a capability name is <Phase>.<operation>; it resolves only against a binding of that phase whose @resources declare the operation
